page.overview:
Who is Sean Lennon?

He shares his birthday with his father who gave up music for five years just to take care of him. Sean never knew his father was a Beatle until he saw the film, Yellow Submarine, at his childhood friend's house one afternoon. In February of 2006 Sean realesed an Album called friendly fire. Even though the Album was named friendly fire and had a song with the same name, it was not the biggest song on the album. The biggest song on the album was a song called Dead Meat which was, coincidentally, 'big in Japan.'
